author: root
accepted_claims: Product of two Suzuki involutions has order one, two or odd.
Displayed opposite-root product with a diagonal middle term is not an involution.
The two proper face groups of a generating rotation marking cannot both lie in Borels or odd-torus normalizers.
No chiral rank-four polytope with rotation group Sz(2^N) for odd prime N.
retained_inputs: Classical Suzuki ovoid, involution centralizers, exponent-four Sylow 2-groups and maximal-subgroup classification
Standard rotation and reflection-extension criterion, with duality
limits: No full F003, all-rank or almost-simple conclusion.
No new original, conjecture, numerical or Lean credit.
Optional diagnostic computations are not proof premises and were not rerun.
source_edition_limit: The supplied arXiv v1 is bound; no claim of reading a later journal edition.
